title: Mandela Syndrome
description:
A mysterious organization, an unexpected job offering, strange entities and a world seemingly erasing itself from existence. Do what you can to help save the world from deterioration, and keep tomorrow coming. 

In this first person horror simulator you will complete a number of timed "crate based" puzzles, with the assistance of your control boards and the tools provided by your corporate overlords. Throughout the course of the game's four levels will you come to master the many mechanics to control your job, filter crates, conduct stability tests, and help keep the facility running. 

And lastly, just try not to get fired.
description_short: A horror puzzle game about keeping the world from being forgotten, one box at a time. Control multiple switchboards, solve puzzle minigames and survive the horrors of this strange Association.
